payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed gating mechanism is specifically designed to effectively handle cases where there is only one sentence in a bag, addressing the limitations of selective attention in such scenarios.

claims.text: The proposed gating mechanism is designed to handle one-sentence bags effectively, preventing noise representation from being propagated even when the single sentence is wrongly labeled.
Unlike selective attention, which is ineffective for one-sentence bags, the gating mechanism maintains stability and consistency across training examples.
